ev.q: a total of 18 human infections with H3N2v virus (12 from Michigan and six from Ohio)
Thirteen persons reported direct contact with swine (touching or handling)
Eight of the 18 ill persons were at high risk for influenza-associated complications
Influenza A(H3N2) variant virus infections (N = 18), by date of symptom onset
Sixteen of the ill persons were aged <18 years, including seven aged <5 years.

five of the 18 infections occurred in persons who did not report direct swine contact
